name: Aphelion of Ceres
description:
**Eclipses** Slingshot and Newton's Meteor. Blocks fired by Slingshots instead fire as meteors, and your meteors apply the damage and effects their block would when fired by a Slingshot, then crumble after 3 hits.
- **Eclipse: **The behavior of the eclipsed object is replaced while wearing this Aphelion.
